celebrations.speaker: MAY
celebrations.text:
MAY: You did it!
You trusted every POKeMON.
That bond carried you through.
Take it to both LEAGUES!

celebrations.speaker: LEAF
celebrations.text:
LEAF: Congratulations!
You kept reading our next move.
Keep that clear head when the
LEAGUE puts you under pressure.

celebrations.speaker: BRENDAN
celebrations.text:
BRENDAN: What a finish!
Every journey made us stronger.
We have more trails to explore,
but your next stop is the LEAGUE!

celebrations.speaker: Luffy
celebrations.text:
Luffy: That was awesome!
You never gave up on your crew!
I am chasing my own big dream.
Go chase those LEAGUE titles!

celebrations.speaker: Eren
celebrations.text:
Eren: Congratulations.
You chose your path and held on.
The next challenge is your choice.
Keep moving forward, freely.
